meta.title: Signature Projects — ACC & Associates
meta.description: Signature ACC engagements: commercial, industrial, health and infrastructure projects across NSW. Independent commercial oversight, evidence-controlled delivery.

intro.headline: See the discipline in action.
intro.lede: Every signature engagement below follows the same 10-stage discipline — from feasibility through handover — with evidence at every step.

items.title: Caltex Refinery & Terminal Works
items.brief: Independent commercial oversight across restricted hazardous zones.
outcomes: WHS-first program integration with plant operations.
Handover accepted first-pass against Commonwealth EPA obligations.

items.title: Day-Surgery Precinct
items.brief: Contract administration and superintendent support during a critical delivery phase.
outcomes: RFI, variation and EOT registers run to close-out.
Monthly progress claims certified inside contract windows.

items.title: School Masterplan
items.brief: Board-ready read on cost, programme and risk before authorising tender.
outcomes: Elemental cost plan benchmarked against comparable projects.
Risk register issued alongside the cost plan and presented to the board.

items.title: Logistics Estate
items.brief: Independent cost check ahead of award; superintendent role through construction.
outcomes: Trade-level estimate closed the gap to the tendered price.
Monthly certificates and formal determinations delivered on-schedule.
